- **Knowledge Recall** (integer, 0-100): Factual knowledge and world knowledge retrieval

from pathlib import Path

async def render():
    html_path = Path("/app/output/chart.html").resolve()
    output_path = Path("/app/output/result.png").resolve()

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox'])
        page = await browser.new_page(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900},
            device_scale_factor=2
        )
        # Use file:// URL
        await page.goto(f"file://{html_path}", wait_until="networkidle", timeout=15000)

        # Wait for D3 SVG to render
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        # Take screenshot of the chart area
        chart = await page.query_selector("#chartWrapper")
        if chart:
            await chart.screenshot(path=str(output_path), type="png")
            print(f"Screenshot saved to {output_path}")
        else:
            # Fallback: full page
            await page.screenshot(path=str(output_path), full_page=True)
            print(f"Fallback screenshot to {output_path}")

        await browser.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(render())

        # Screenshot the chart wrapper

        if chart:

            print(f"Screenshot saved to {output_path}")
        else:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(output_path), full_page=True)
            print(f"Fallback screenshot to {output_path}")

        await browser.close()
